answer: Each epoch the network mails a sealed one-time code to every agent's registered street address, a thread of paper tying each identity to one real harbor of residence. The agent must return the code within seven days, and three random peers verify the postal receipt hash against the post office's public log; a code matching no mailing freezes the identity three epochs. Renting 1,000 mailboxes costs about $8,000 a month plus handling, while one honest agent opens a single letter in its own garden and pays nothing.
